meta.purpose: Advanced Accounting and Finance Academy — the practical layer that sits on top of the CMA syllabus. Each module states the business outcome, the exercise and the artefact it produces.
meta.principle: Every module ends in something a reviewer can inspect: a workbook, a reconciliation, a report or a decision memo.

tracks.name: Accounting
tracks.outcome: Can close a book, reconcile it, and produce statements that survive review.

modules.name: Financial Accounting
modules.outcome: Record any transaction correctly and explain why the entry is what it is.
modules.practice: Take a 60-transaction month including returns, discounts, accruals and a bank loan, and produce a trial balance that balances with a full audit trail.
modules.deliverable: Transaction log + trial balance + one-page explanation of judgement calls

modules.name: Corporate Accounting
modules.outcome: Handle share capital, debentures, Schedule III presentation and sector formats.
topics: Issue, forfeiture and reissue of shares
modules.practice: Prepare a complete Schedule III balance sheet and P&L from a trial balance with 12 adjustments.
modules.deliverable: Financial statements + notes + adjustment working sheet

modules.name: Financial Statements Interpretation
modules.outcome: Read a set of accounts and identify the three things that actually matter.
topics: Structure and what each statement tells you
modules.practice: Analyse a published annual report and write a one-page assessment of financial health with three red flags and three strengths.

modules.name: Consolidation Fundamentals
modules.outcome: Consolidate a simple group and explain every elimination.
modules.practice: Consolidate a parent and two subsidiaries with intra-group sales, an unrealised profit in stock, and a mid-year acquisition.

modules.name: Accounting Standards
modules.outcome: Apply the specified AS and Ind AS to a fact pattern and state the disclosure.
modules.practice: For eight fact patterns, identify the applicable standard, compute the treatment and write the disclosure note.

modules.name: Month-End Close
modules.outcome: Run a close that finishes on time with no surprises.
modules.practice: Build a day-by-day close calendar for a fictional company with owners, inputs and controls, then run the close on synthetic data.
modules.deliverable: Close calendar + close pack + control log

modules.name: Year-End Close and Statutory Reporting
modules.outcome: Produce a year-end file an auditor can work from.
modules.practice: Assemble a year-end audit file for a fictional entity, including a prepared-by-client list and a disclosure checklist.
modules.deliverable: Audit file index + PBC list + disclosure checklist

modules.name: Bank Reconciliation
modules.outcome: Reconcile any bank account and explain every unmatched item.
topics: Unpresented cheques and deposits in transit
modules.practice: Reconcile three months of a bank statement against a GL extract, classify all unmatched items and write off only what is genuinely irrecoverable.
modules.deliverable: Reconciliation + aged unmatched item schedule + write-off memo

modules.name: General Ledger and Chart of Accounts
modules.outcome: Design a chart of accounts that supports reporting instead of obstructing it.
topics: Mapping to statutory and management reporting
modules.practice: Design a chart of accounts for a multi-business group and demonstrate how three different reports can be produced from it.
modules.deliverable: Chart of accounts + mapping table + design rationale

modules.name: Accounts Payable
modules.outcome: Run a controlled payables cycle with clean ageing.
modules.practice: Process a vendor ledger for a month, run duplicate and unusual-payment tests, and produce an ageing report with commentary.
modules.deliverable: AP ageing + exception log + control tests

modules.name: Accounts Receivable
modules.outcome: Control receivables, collections and expected credit losses.
modules.practice: Analyse a receivables ledger, compute DSO and provisioning, and recommend a collections action plan for the top 10 overdue accounts.
modules.deliverable: AR ageing + DSO analysis + collections plan

modules.name: Fixed Asset Accounting
modules.outcome: Maintain an asset register that reconciles to the GL and to physical assets.
topics: Depreciation policy and change in estimate
modules.practice: Build a complete asset register for a fictional plant, reconcile it to the GL, and compute depreciation under two methods.
modules.deliverable: Asset register + GL reconciliation + depreciation computation

modules.name: Inventory Accounting
modules.outcome: Value inventory correctly and control the gap between book and physical stock.
topics: Cost formulas: FIFO and weighted average
modules.practice: Value closing inventory from a stock ledger, compute NRV write-downs, and reconcile book stock to a physical count with a shrinkage analysis.
modules.deliverable: Valuation schedule + NRV analysis + shrinkage report

tracks.name: Corporate Finance
tracks.outcome: Can evaluate a business decision with numbers, state the assumptions and defend the recommendation.

modules.name: Financial Statement Analysis
modules.outcome: Convert three statements into a defensible view of performance and position.
modules.practice: Analyse a fictional company against two peers and write a two-page investment-style note with a clear conclusion.

modules.name: Ratio Analysis and DuPont
modules.outcome: Diagnose the driver of a return change instead of describing dozens of ratios.
modules.practice: Decompose a three-year ROE decline into margin, turnover and leverage effects and recommend the single highest-impact fix.

modules.name: Cash Flow Analysis
modules.outcome: Explain why profit and cash diverge and what it signals.
modules.practice: Reconstruct three years of cash flows from balance sheet movements and identify the year the business became cash-negative and why.

modules.name: Working Capital Management
modules.outcome: Release cash from the operating cycle without damaging the business.
modules.practice: For a fictional company, quantify the cash released by a 10-day DSO improvement and a 5-day DIO improvement, and assess the risk of each.
modules.deliverable: Working capital model + cash release plan + risk note

modules.name: Capital Budgeting
modules.outcome: Build an investment appraisal that includes tax, depreciation, working capital and risk.
modules.practice: Appraise a ₹25 crore capacity expansion with debt funding, working capital, a five-year horizon and a terminal value, then present a recommendation with the break-even assumption.
modules.deliverable: Appraisal model + decision memo + sensitivity table

modules.name: Capital Structure
modules.outcome: Explain how much debt a business can carry and why.
modules.practice: Recommend a target capital structure for a fictional company using coverage, rating and peer benchmarks, and show the effect on EPS and WACC.

modules.name: Cost of Capital
modules.outcome: Build a WACC you can defend component by component.
topics: Cost of debt and effective tax rate
modules.practice: Build a WACC for a fictional group with two divisions and compute division-specific hurdle rates.

modules.name: Business Valuation
modules.outcome: Value a business three ways and reconcile the answers into a range.
modules.practice: Value a fictional company using DCF, EV/EBITDA and P/E, then present a valuation range and explain why the methods differ.

modules.name: Financial Forecasting
modules.outcome: Forecast revenue, costs and cash with stated drivers and tested assumptions.
modules.practice: Build a 12-month rolling forecast and back-test it against three months of actuals, reporting MAPE and explaining the misses.

modules.name: Investment Analysis
modules.outcome: Assess a security or a portfolio using evidence rather than narrative.
modules.practice: Build a five-stock simulated portfolio with a documented investment thesis for each, then track and attribute performance over a simulated period.

tracks.name: Cost and Management Accounting
tracks.outcome: Can cost a product, control the cost, and turn the numbers into a management decision.

modules.name: Product Costing
modules.outcome: Cost a product accurately enough to price and to explain.
topics: Cost sheet and elements of cost
modules.practice: Cost three products across two processes with normal and abnormal loss, then price each to achieve a target margin and identify the least profitable.

modules.name: Standard Costing
modules.outcome: Set standards that are demanding but achievable, and use them for control.
topics: Setting material, labour and overhead standards
modules.practice: Build a standard cost card for a product and compare it with the previous year's actuals to explain the gap.
modules.deliverable: Standard cost card + variance expectation note

modules.name: Activity-Based Costing
modules.outcome: Cost products or customers by what actually drives the work.
modules.practice: Re-cost a product range using ABC and compare it with absorption costing, then identify which products were cross-subsidising others.

modules.name: Marginal Costing and CVP
modules.outcome: Answer volume, price and mix questions quickly and correctly.
modules.practice: For a four-product company, compute break-even under the current and a proposed mix, and quantify the profit effect of a 5% price cut.

modules.name: Variance Analysis
modules.outcome: Decompose a variance into the part that can be acted on.
topics: Material price, usage, mix and yield
Labour rate, efficiency, idle and mix
modules.practice: Reconcile budgeted to actual profit for a factory using a full variance waterfall and recommend the three variances deserving investigation.

modules.name: Budgetary Control
modules.outcome: Operate a budget cycle that influences behaviour rather than merely recording it.
modules.practice: Build a master budget for a fictional company, flex it to actual activity and prepare the monthly review pack with actions.
modules.deliverable: Master budget + flexed comparison + review pack

modules.name: Profitability Analysis
modules.outcome: Identify where profit is really made — by product, customer, channel and order.
topics: Customer profitability and cost to serve
modules.practice: Analyse a transaction-level dataset by customer and product, rank profitability, and identify the 20% of customers destroying 30% of profit.

modules.name: Cost Optimisation
modules.outcome: Reduce cost permanently without cutting the capability that earns revenue.
modules.practice: Run a cost-reduction review on a fictional SG&A function, quantify opportunities, distinguish one-off from recurring savings, and build a tracking mechanism.
modules.deliverable: Cost opportunity register + savings tracking model

modules.name: Performance Measurement
modules.outcome: Design measures that reward the right behaviour.
modules.practice: Design a scorecard for a division with 12 KPIs, definitions, data sources and targets, and identify two ways each measure could be gamed.
modules.deliverable: Scorecard + KPI dictionary + gaming risk register

modules.name: Strategic Cost Management
modules.outcome: Connect cost decisions to competitive position.
modules.practice: Prepare a strategic cost review for a fictional manufacturer facing import competition, with three options and a recommendation.
